title: Change Order Fee Schedule for Repeated and In-Production Changes
content:
# Change Order Fee Schedule for Repeated and In-Production Changes

Three figures stand behind the administration fee for an agreed change to the specification under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions: the programme's own fee, that fee at 1.5 times itself, and that fee at 2 times itself. Which of them is taken turns on whether a charge for such a change already stands booked on the commission and on whether the piece has gone into production.

## Schedule

| Where | The administration fee is |
|---|---|
| A charge for a change to the specification already stands booked on the commission and the piece has gone into production | The programme's fee taken at 2 times itself |
| No charge for a change to the specification stands booked on the commission and the piece has gone into production | The programme's fee taken at 1.5 times itself |
| Otherwise | The programme's fee for a change to the specification as the programme sets it |

A charge for a change to the specification stands booked where at least one such charge has been booked to the commission; the piece has gone into production where the date production began stands on the commission, and has not where that date is empty.

## The programme's fee

| Programme | Fee for a change to the specification |
|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | USD 95.00 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | USD 150.00 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | USD 275.00 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | USD 450.00 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | USD 325.00 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | USD 950.00 |

## Worked readings (hypothetical)

- A Belrose Bespoke Design commission, one change already charged, production begun: the fee is 2 times USD 275.00, that is USD 550.00.
- The same commission with no change yet charged and production begun: the fee is 1.5 times USD 275.00, that is USD 412.50.
- The same commission with production not yet begun: the fee is the programme's own, USD 275.00.
- A Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission with one change already charged and production begun: the fee is 2 times USD 950.00, that is USD 1900.00.
